subject: MAP: SDK streaming & toolcall build — kickoff recap & owners
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@healthgrid.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — next steps / MAP kickoff

Thanks for the demo this morning — quick recap and asks from our side so we can fold them into the MAP: 

Summary of what we heard (HealthGrid priorities)
- Low-latency streaming for clinician chat (target 200-300ms per token)
- Deterministic structured outputs for charting entries (JSON schema required)
- Tool calling to surface patient lookup and order entry (auth + audit trails)

Immediate asks / dependencies
1) Draft MAP milestones for the Integration Build (SDK integration, streaming, tool calls, structured outputs) with owners and target dates — we want a single page we can share with Legal/Procurement.
2) Risk callouts: any blockers on our side (PII scope, network/VPN, KMS)
3) Sample structured-output schema or example payloads to validate end-to-end tests

Target business timeline: Q3 pilot; preferred GA by end of Q4 2026. Critical path is engineering readiness + security signoff by procurement.

Attachments: I attached our internal SOW outline (we'll share a finalized doc next week).

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Sr. Product Manager, HealthGrid
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SDK streaming & toolcall build — kickoff recap & owners

Samira — really helpful framing, thanks. Per our call I drafted a compact MAP milestone sheet and attached a working XLS (MAP_HealthGrid_v0.1.xlsx). High level proposal below. If this looks reasonable we will finalize dates and owners and push the file to the shared Drive link.

Proposed MAP milestone table (high level)
- Milestone: SDK integration (client libraries, auth flows): Owner — Ben Carter; Target: 2026-07-22; Dependencies: API keys, example requests from HealthGrid
- Milestone: Streaming + latency tuning (batching policy, KV caching): Owner — Dev Patel; Target: 2026-08-05; Dependencies: baseline load patterns, test dataset for token distribution
- Milestone: Tool calling (patient lookup, order endpoints, audit headers): Owner — Marissa Cole; Target: 2026-08-19; Dependencies: API endpoints, auth sequence (OAuth2 or mTLS)
- Milestone: Structured outputs (schema + validation harness): Owner — HealthGrid (Samira / Alec) + Redwood engineering review; Target: 2026-07-29; Dependencies: example payloads, desired fields for EHR ingestion
- Milestone: End-to-end pilot & SLA smoke tests: Owner — Ben Carter; Target: 2026-09-02; Dependencies: test harness, prod-like infra

Critical path note: structured outputs schema and procurement signoff are gating for pilot. We flagged some security questions in the attached checklist.

Next steps (this week)
1) Ben — confirm SDK owner and internal resource estimate (2-week cadence)
2) Dev — create a streaming test plan and proposed batching policy
3) Samira/Alec — upload an example structured-output payload (JSON) and confirm auth approach for tool calls
4) Marissa — confirm legal/procurement contacts so we can route MAP for review

Attachments referenced:
- MAP_HealthGrid_v0.1.xlsx (working MAP table)
- sdk-integration-checklist.pdf (initial ops/security checklist)

If you want, we can set a short 30-minute alignment this week to lock dates.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SDK streaming & toolcall build — kickoff recap & owners

On Mon, Jun 7, 2026 at 11:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Propled MAP milestone table...

Quick technical notes / risks from the runtime side:
- SDK integration: Ben — happy to own the integration hooks with client SDKs (JS, Python). We should scope a minimal public API that supports streaming and non-streaming flows. ETA: PR-ready wrappers by 2026-07-15 if we have sample requests.
- Streaming: Latency target 200-300ms per token is aggressive depending on sequence length and model choice. We can meet it under dedicated capacity with optimized batching, but need to confirm model selection (open LLM variant) and qps. Also need network egress tuning for HealthGrid's VPC.
- Tool calling: We recommend starting with deferred tool call mode (server-side call after token emission) to simplify auth and audit. If HealthGrid requires synchronous tool invocation, schedule extra engineering time for websocket-based callbacks.
- Structured outputs: Biggest risk. We need concrete JSON schema examples; if HealthGrid can provide 10 representative charting payloads we can build a validation harness and regression tests. Also call out potential need for redaction hooks if PHI fields are present.

I'll draft the streaming test plan and attach a preliminary checklist in the Drive link. Ben/Marissa — can you confirm owner bandwidth?

— Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
